name: Timeline
summary: Experience or history as an ordered list: each entry a date, a title and a line of detail.

guidance.useFor: A CV's roles, a studio's history, a project's milestones.
content: Write ranges as people say them: "2021 - 2024", "2024 - now"
The title is the role or event; the detail, the place and what happened

rungReason: An <ol> keeps the order and count; <time datetime> makes a single date machine-readable.

attributes.datetime: on <time>, a valid date or year

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

rules: A range isn't a valid datetime: it is a <span>, and a single date or year is a <time>
The date column wraps above the entry when narrow (WCAG 1.4.10)
